opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: Up to £500,000 for research; in special cases, and by prior agreement, up to £750,000. Most grants awarded are below £300,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to UK-based organisations. Does not fund individuals without formal employment or contractual relationship with the hosting institution, projects led by individuals unaffiliated to an organisation, projects led by schools/FE colleges, projects led by undergraduates or master's students, PhD fees, establishment of academic posts, dissemination-only projects, local charities, or overseas organisations except in exceptional cases.
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the Foundation's five interconnected priority questions and aim to improve lives in the UK. Two application deadlines a year (Spring and Autumn); outline application deadline 5 October 2026.

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to UK-based applicants. Encourages applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly individuals and organisations from racially minoritised communities, and partnership applications bringing together researchers and racially minoritised communities.
opportunities.summary: Research funding to understand the barriers and pathways to a racially just and inclusive society. One deadline a year (Autumn); next deadline 5 October 2026. 2026 priority theme: Inter-generational changes, continuities and challenges in a racially diverse UK.
